title: Kartik Network
tagline: Engagement Protocol build with Farcaster Frames. Secured my SAFE, empowered trough $KARTIK Coin on Base..
description:
The Kartik Network is a decentralized engagement protocol, powered & secured by the Kartik Coin ($KARTIK).

It empowers builders in the ETHGlobal ecosystem to build consumer applications, while being rewarded.

Furthermore $KARTIK will reward consumers for taking engaging actions.

A great demonstration of that is the Farcaster Frame we have built:
An engaging Quiz that rewards you in $KARTIK Token, furthermore it creates a SAFE Account for the User.
how_its_made:
Tech Stack:

- Foundry
- Next.js
- onchainkit for Frames

The Frame is empowered by th QuizContract. It takes in the Users created SAFE Address and drops it some $KARTIK trough a sponsored Transaction by pimlico.

Besides that the Frame offers Users to engage in interesting and educating Questions about Kartik, ETHGlobal & web3.
